objective: Connect the AI cover backend to real AWS clients and expose it at /api/cover.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Create src/lib/ai-cover-aws.ts and src/app/api/cover/route.ts exactly as specified in the acceptance test header, following src/lib/description-aws.ts and src/app/api/description/route.ts. All files the new code depends on are shown: src/lib/ai-cover.ts, src/lib/ai-cover-backend.ts and src/lib/ai-cover-service.ts are reference-only and must not change.

ai-cover-aws.ts: aiCoverBackend(upload: (path: string, bytes: Uint8Array, contentType: string) => Promise<void>) returns createCoverBackend({ commit, now, getItem, updateItem, transactWrite, invokeModel, upload }) from ./ai-cover-backend. now() returns Unix seconds. getItem/updateItem/transactWrite each send one GetItemCommand/UpdateItemCommand/TransactWriteItemsCommand with the given input; invokeModel({ modelId, contentType, accept, body: string }) sends one InvokeModelCommand with body as bytes and returns response.body (Uint8Array). The deps parameter types are narrower than the SDK types, so cast inputs and the GetItem output through unknown. AI_COVER_REGION comes from ./ai-cover.

route.ts: GET and POST call coverRequest(request, { authorize, backend, env }) from @/lib/ai-cover-service. authorize(id) returns { owner: user.id, title } or null. backend is () => aiCoverBackend(upload) where upload stores to the bonus-generated bucket with the request's server Supabase client (@/lib/supabase/server, as the description route does), contentType as given and upsert: false, throwing a fixed error on failure. env must be a plain object with exactly VERCEL_ENV, VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, BONUS_AI_COVER_ACTIVATION_SHA and BONUS_AI_COVER_ROLE_ARN copied from process.env (passing process.env itself does not type-check).
No other files change; no UI in this task. Never add retries, service-role keys or long-lived AWS credentials.
Keep the change small: two new files; a repair should change only what its findings require.
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks, together with the existing ai-cover acceptance tests; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Computed by the coding assistant from a separate read-only clone with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (119 files, 742610 bytes); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
